# WoofLog

> WoofLog is a free iPhone app — a private health diary for dogs. Dog owners log symptoms, medications, and weight in seconds and build a clear, date-ordered history to show the vet. All data stays on the device: no account, no sign-up.

## What it is
- Platform: iOS (iPhone). Price: free, no in-app purchases.
- App Store category: Lifestyle. It is a diary/record for owners — it is not a medical device and does not diagnose, treat, or give veterinary advice.
- Supports up to five dogs, each with their own record — switch between them in a tap, see at a glance which dog has a dose due, and archive a dog you no longer track without losing their history.
- Available in English, Spanish, German, French, Italian, and Portuguese.
- Made by an independent developer for his own dog.

## What you can log
- Symptoms — skin & coat, ears, eyes, stool (poop), vomiting, urinary (pee), and mobility — each with a severity and an optional photo, in a couple of taps.
- Medications — log each dose as you give it and see the last 7 days at a glance.
- Weight — record your dog's weight and see how it changes over time.
- Free-form notes for anything else.

## History
- Every entry appears in one History, organized by date, so you can look back at how things have changed and walk into the vet with the full picture.

## Privacy
- Local-first: your dog's health data (symptoms, photos, weight, notes) stays on your iPhone.
- No account or sign-up. Optional anonymous product analytics are off by default and can be turned on in Settings.
